_note: AUTHORED. Primitive token steps that component code may still use, each with its reason and exact count per file (token-lint semantic-radius, roadmap M5.1; M5.2 adds spacing). A count that no longer matches fails, so migrating a use means lowering or removing its entry; an entry with no matching use fails as stale. A use stays primitive only when no role fits its meaning — never because the role's value differs.
